overview: Antigua and Barbuda is a small island country in the eastern Caribbean, made up of two main islands and several smaller ones. Its capital, St. John's, is on Antigua. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1981, and the British monarch is still its head of state. Tourism is by far the biggest part of its economy.

geography.text: Antigua is low and hilly, with a coastline full of bays, beaches and coral reefs; it is often said to have a beach for every day of the year. Barbuda, to the north, is flat and much less populated, and its large lagoon is home to a colony of frigate birds. The islands lie in the path of Atlantic hurricanes.
